  "cons": [
    "Learning curve for advanced administrative features and configurations.",
    "Potential for a disjointed user experience when switching between the vault and admin console.",
    "Customer support responsiveness or discoverability of help articles could be improved."

  "overall_experience": "The Setup Lead likely found Bitwarden to be a highly valuable solution for managing and sharing secure passwords across their mid-market company, appreciating its strong security framework and competitive pricing. While the core functionality for team management and sharing was effective, they may have encountered a learning curve with more complex administrative configurations and a somewhat fragmented user interface between the personal vault and the admin console. Despite these minor frustrations, the overall benefit of secure, centralized password management at an excellent price point made it a strong recommendation."
